item.title: 4th Sobh International Media Festival opens call for entries
item.description: The Sobh International Media Festival, a prestigious media event in Iran, has opened its call for submissions for the fourth edition.

item.title: Top trade official urges tapping border provinces’ potential to counter economic pressure
item.description: The official says commercial exchanges should be developed in line with the economic capacities on both sides of Iran's borders.

item.title: Tehran rejects IAEA’s ‘entirely unreasonable’ inspection of bombed nuclear sites: Top MP
item.description: A senior Iranian lawmaker has described the IAEA’s request to inspect the bombed nuclear facilities as “entirely unreasonable” and lacking any legal basis.

item.title: Iran has exposed deep vulnerabilities in US warfare strategy: IRGC deputy chief
item.description: The latest war exposed vulnerabilities on the other side, the IRGC’s deputy commander says.

item.title: Iran dismantles four terrorist cells, arrests 27 in West Azarbaijan
item.description: The Intelligence Ministry said the four separatist groups had been organizing terrorist operations and activities aimed at creating insecurity inside the country as part of an “American-Zionist plan.”

item.title: Tehran: Hormuz security can be restored fast if US honors commitments
item.description: The Foreign Ministry spokesman says Iran’s conditions are not extraordinary demands but its legitimate rights.

item.title: Renowned Iranian novelist and travel writer Reza Amirkhani passes away at 53
item.description: Amirkhani gained widespread recognition with his 1999 novel Man-e Ou (The Self of Him), a work that drew on extensive research into old Tehran and explored themes of love, identity, tradition, and social change.

item.title: IRGC says it has shot down 78 US MQ-9 and MQ-1 drones
item.description: The Islamic Revolution Guards Corps says its advanced air defense systems have destroyed 58 MQ-9 Reaper and 20 MQ-1 Predator drones, highlighting Iran's growing capability to counter sophisticated aerial threats.

item.title: IRGC deputy commander warns of US-led plot to fuel unrest and destabilize Iran
item.description: Major General Mostafa Izadi says adversaries are seeking to exploit economic pressure and psychological warfare to undermine public confidence.

item.title: Two oil supertankers explode in Strait of Hormuz; IRGC Navy warns shipping companies
item.description: The IRGC Navy's public relations office said the two tankers had violated navigation instructions issued by the force and were sailing through prohibited routes in the strategic waterway.

item.title: Iran Navy: Two violating tankers catch fire after striking naval mines in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: The Iranian Navy says two oil tankers caught fire after striking naval mines in a prohibited area east of the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Iran files lawsuits in US, Europe over Minab school massacre
item.description: The Iranian government has submitted evidence to courts in the US and four European countries over the US attack on an elementary school in Minab.

item.title: UN: Violence, displacement continue in Gaza despite ceasefire
item.description: The UN secretary general warned of the continuation of violence and displacement in the Gaza Strip despite the ceasefire.

item.title: Indonesian rescuers scour fire-damaged factory for missing people
item.description: Indonesian rescuers look for 36 people still missing after the blaze killed three.

item.title: Firefighters tackle blaze after explosion on gas-powered bus in Barcelona
item.description: A gas-powered bus caught fire following an explosion in Barcelona, Spain, sparking a major blaze. No casualties were reported.
